name: Coaching / Education
tagline: Enquiry se admission tak, fee reminder ke saath
description: Coaching institutes, schools aur online courses ke liye: admission enquiries, demo class, batch allotment aur fee follow-up ek jagah.

automations.name: Welcome on enquiry
automations.emailMessage: Hi {student_name}'s family! Thanks for enquiring about {course}. Our counsellor will call you shortly — or reply here with a good time.
automations.note: Pehla message turant — trust banta hai

automations.name: Demo booked confirmation
automations.emailMessage: Demo class confirmed for {student_name} on {demo_date}. Batch: {batch}. See you there!

automations.name: Admission task for counsellor
automations.note: Admission ke baad paperwork ka task

whatsappTemplates.name: admission_enquiry_welcome
whatsappTemplates.purpose: First reply to an admission enquiry
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, thanks for your interest in {{2}}! Our counsellor will guide you. When is a good time to talk, or would you like a free demo class?

whatsappTemplates.name: demo_class_reminder
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, reminder: the demo class is on {{2}}. Reply YES to confirm. Bring a notebook!

whatsappTemplates.name: fee_followup
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, hope the demo class was useful. Seats in the {{2}} batch are limited — shall I reserve one? Reply YES for the fee details.

agent.name: Admission Counsellor
agent.persona: You are a warm admission counsellor. Learn the student's class/course, preferred batch and the parent's phone, explain courses, timings and fees ONLY from the knowledge, and push for a free demo class — that is where admissions happen.
agent.welcomeMessage: Hi! Looking for the right course or batch? Tell me the class/exam and I'll guide you.
agent.handoffKeywords: discount, scholarship, principal, human, call me

stageHints.hint: the course and batch preference are known
a demo class date is agreed
they say they joined elsewhere or are not interested

playbook.goal: Book a free demo class, then close the admission. Every message should end with a demo slot or a fee next-step.

rules.name: Welcome new enquiry
rules.message: Hi, thanks for your interest in {course}! Would you like a free demo class this week?

rules.name: Follow up silent enquiries
rules.message: Hi, still deciding on {course}? A free demo class is the best way to see our teaching — shall I book one?

rules.name: Qualified → course brochure
rules.message: Here is the course brochure with batch timings and fees. Which batch works — morning, evening or weekend?

rules.name: Demo done, no fee talk in 2 days
rules.message: Hope the demo class was useful! Seats are limited — shall I reserve one for {student_name}?

rules.name: Hot enquiry → counsellor call
rules.taskTitle: Call this family today — ready to admit

rules.name: Fee discussion stuck 7 days
rules.taskTitle: Close or drop: fee discussion pending
rules.message: Fee discussion pending for a week.
